correctness.rationale: For y²=xg(x²) with reciprocal quartic g(z)=z⁴+s z³+(t+2)z²+s z+1 in characteristic 7, squarefreeness is exactly Delta=(s²-4t)((t+4)²-4s²) nonzero. Cartier coefficient extraction from f³ gives 4x4 matrix with two 2x2 blocks each determinant P=2s⁴+2s²t²+2s²t+s²+4t²+2t-1 modulo7, and each contains a fixed entry 1. Therefore ranks can only be 4 or2, a-number respectively 0 or2 over the entire algebraic closure. Independently expanded f³ and verified AB-D=P as symbolic polynomial identity, independently checked all 49 F7 parameter pairs: 31 smooth and only (2,5),(5,5) on P=0 with Delta nonzero; both Cartier matrices square to zero so stable 7-rank zero, the other 29 smooth pairs ordinary. Finite enumeration addresses F7-only census; the symbolic determinant identity proves the geometric all-parameter statement.
